summary: The proposal addresses a relevant integration problem and presents a plausible solution direction with supporting references and an initial workflow. However, it is not ready for submission because required sections and an AI transparency statement are missing, the bibliography and figure requirements are unmet, and the problem and design presentation need substantial restructuring.

findings.title: Missing Introduction section
findings.description: Add a distinct Introduction section before the Problem section. It should briefly introduce the thesis context, scope, and the issue addressed by the proposal.

findings.title: Missing Motivation section
findings.description: Add a dedicated Motivation section explaining the scientific and educational importance of integrating Artemis with GitLab CI, the benefits expected from the work, and a positive vision of the resulting capability. Do not merely repeat current limitations or describe implementation details.

findings.title: Missing Objective section and required objective subsections
findings.description: Replace the current Section 4 structure with a required Objective section. Begin it with a short introduction and a one-line bullet list of 3–4 high-level objectives, followed by one subsection for each objective; each subsection must contain at least two paragraphs.

locations.section: System Requirements and Top Level Design

findings.title: Bibliography contains fewer than the required minimum number of publications
findings.description: The bibliography contains only five publications. Add at least one more peer-reviewed publication to meet the minimum of six, preferably expanding the bibliography to six to eight relevant peer-reviewed sources.

locations.quote: [Booch95] Booch, G. Object-oriented analysis and design with applications (2. ed.).
[Krusche17] Krusche, S.; Seitz, A.; Borstler, J.; Brugge, B. Interactive learning: Increasing student participation through shorter exercise cycles.
[Krusche18] Krusche, S.; Seitz, A. ArTEMiS: An Automatic Assessment Management System for Interactive Learning.

findings.title: Fewer than two figures included
findings.description: Add at least one additional diagram, mockup, screenshot, or chart so that the proposal contains at least two figures.

findings.title: AI transparency statement is missing
findings.description: Add a dedicated first-person AI transparency statement that names each AI tool used, explains its purpose, identifies the sections in which it was used, and confirms that all AI-generated text was checked for correctness and coherence.

findings.title: The Problem section presents desired solutions
findings.description: Revise the Problem section so that it describes only the current limitation and its consequences. Move desired capabilities and solution-oriented requirements to the objectives or solution section.

locations.quote: In exams, **it would be useful to change the student build plans after the submission date** to firstly hide the test cases during the exam and only compile the code and secondly use a debug compiler not failing due to a simple syntax error.

findings.title: Workflow section relies too heavily on a numbered list
findings.description: Section 4 relies too heavily on a 14-step numbered workflow. Retain the sequence if necessary, but introduce and explain it in prose, and use paragraphs to describe the roles, system interactions, and design implications rather than presenting nearly the entire section as a list.

locations.section: System Requirements and Top Level Design
locations.quote: **3) Flow of events: 1. Bob prepares the exercise via the web interface of Artemis and pushes the exercise code template, the test cases as well as the sample solution to the VC server [Krusche18]. 2. Artemis configures the build plan accordingly to the configuration made by Bob and makes it available via the API.**

findings.title: Figure 1 is not explicitly referenced
findings.description: Reference Figure 1 explicitly by its figure number in the surrounding text, and reference any additional figure similarly. Replace the generic reference to section 4 with wording such as “Figure 1 shows the top-level workflow.”

findings.title: Several paragraphs are too short
findings.description: Expand each standalone one- to two-line paragraph with relevant rationale, scope, or expected implications, or merge it with an adjacent paragraph if it does not warrant separate treatment.

locations.quote: **In addition, universities will save time and money as they will need at least one less server.**

**The proposed solution opens up new opportunities for further research. with the envisaged implementation it will be possible to tackle the problem regarding the test execution during exams described in section 1.**
**In addition, either Ansible or a Kubernetes cluster can be used for automatic deployment of the GitLab CI Runners.**

findings.title: Inconsistent terminology for the CI component
findings.description: Use one consistent term for the CI component throughout the proposal. Distinguish terms only when they refer to genuinely different entities.

locations.quote: The interactive learning platform Artemis currently only supports setups with an external **CI server**.
it is possible to reduce the efort required to maintain the servers and migrate the **CI service** from external applications as Jenkins to the inbuilt CI service.
GitLab CI is the **CI system** provided by the GitLab VC server.
